blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Government Service Insurance System (GSIS) reported a 13.9 percent increase in profits in the first nine months of 2026, driven by investment income and member contributions. On Thursday, the state-run pension fund for government workers said in a statement that it netted P123 billion from January to September, up from P108 billion a year earlier. READ: GSIS H1 profit jumps 28 percent GSIS said its gross revenue rose 8.6 percent to P278 billion, pushing its total assets to P2.07 trillion, up over 7 percent.
